items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads A1 into each sample well followed by 10 mix cycles of 40 uL; the 5 min incubation comment (Step 2) precedes the magnet comment.
Step 3 comment records magnet engage and settle; the log shows 90 uL aspirate/dispense to waste A1 for all 96 wells, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol add and 200 uL removal to waste.
Comments record the 5 min air dry, magnet disengage, 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage; the log shows 50 uL water added to each well followed by 10 mix cycles.
Log shows 45 uL aspirated from each sample_plate well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well (A1->A1 through H12->H12).
Every well gets its own pick up tip and drop tip in all steps (bead addition, supernatant removal, ethanol removal, elution, transfer); there is no tip reuse across samples.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and the run log matches the task for all 96 wells in every step. Incubation, magnet, drying and disengage steps are recorded with comments, and a fresh tip is used per well throughout.
